question: What alternative division may be applied to the previously declared parts according to rule?
premises: A seven-by-seven division is presented as an option.
This division applies to the parts already declared.
The procedure must follow the prescribed rule.
inference: Alternatively, each of the declared parts may be divided sevenfold according to the rule.
plain_english: Or there may be a seven-by-seven division in these declared parts, according to the rule.
